title: Abu Dhabi Bounded Land-Use Simulation and Optimization Benchmark
scientific_question: Under identical observed states, demand actions, spatial constraints and evaluation rules, how do a FLUS-style ANN–CA console, the GWM Geospatial Kernel and GeoFM-LDN differ in land-cover allocation, multi-step rollout and constrained planning stress tests for Abu Dhabi city?

does_not_support: exact prediction of Abu Dhabi policy decisions
causal effects of unobserved planning actions
a model of all social and economic activity
transfer to other cities without independent evaluation

spatial_world.name: Abu Dhabi city
spatial_world.boundary_source: OpenStreetMap Nominatim lookup of relation R4479763

historical_demand_note: Historical allocation uses feasible target counts after fixed-water and protected-wetland projection; these may differ from observed target totals, especially for reclamation-related water changes.

class_system.semantic_limit: Remote-sensing land cover; residential, commercial and industrial land use are not inferred without authoritative planning data.

state_contract.alignment_rule: Every raster must exactly match the canonical CRS, transform, width and height.

action_contract.oracle_demand_rule: Observed target counts may be used only in allocation-skill evaluation and must be marked observed_allocation.
action_contract.scenario_demand_rule: Future target counts must be supplied by the scenario or a demand model using only origin-time information and must be marked scenario_target.

models.comparability_note: Original headline run used seven continuous drivers and frozen default console settings. Feature-expanded runs were subsequently executed with absolute paths. The 25-feature mode is diagnostic-only because five of six platform-seed runs collapsed to zero-change outputs through current-class identity leakage, including all three reviewer-provided Windows x86_64 runs. The 19-feature mode avoids zero-change but underfills observed demand in all three archived macOS seeds. Neither diagnostic is used as a headline estimator or paired model contrast.
models.binary_boundary: Vendored Mach-O arm64 console; valid-input benchmark binary provenance is commit deb0a54, while the retained source tag paper-benchmark-flus-v1.1 at commit 47e65b3 adds fail-closed invalid-input handling without changing valid-input algorithmic paths. It is not claimed bitwise equivalent to an unmodified Liu et al. (2017) release; Windows/Linux require a compatible external build.

frozen_parameters.transition_matrix_policy: water_and_wetland_protected; built_to_nonbuilt transitions not prohibited in legacy run

allocation_skill.purpose: isolate spatial allocation skill from demand forecast error
allocation_skill.degenerate_output_rule: For every model/year/seed, record predicted_change_pixels and zero_change_output; zero-change outputs are diagnostics reviewed alongside structural-zero metrics and are not evidence of superiority or real stability. For the 25-feature FLUS diagnostic, the macOS arm64 seed-31 non-collapse is not a valid point estimate because macOS seeds 47 and 73 and reviewer-provided Windows x86_64 seeds 31, 47 and 73 all include zero-change outputs.

prespecified_label_reliability_sensitivi.rule: origin and target Dynamic World mean-top-probability must both be at least 0.5
prespecified_label_reliability_sensitivi.purpose: quantify sensitivity to annual product-label volatility without hiding full-grid results
prespecified_label_reliability_sensitivi.interpretation_boundary: The dual-year filter and the preceding-year-only variant are label-quality and selection-effect diagnostics, not independent validation sets or model-skill tests.

preceding_year_only_variant.rule: only the Dynamic World mean-top-probability for the year immediately preceding the target must be at least 0.5
preceding_year_only_variant.purpose: expose target-year confidence selection without filtering on the target label

end_to_end_rollout.purpose: measure accumulated state and demand error without observed writeback

planning_optimization.purpose: compare feasible plans under one shared objective and constraint set
planning_optimization.reporting: Pareto frontier plus every descriptive outcome; no hidden weighted aggregate.

acceptable_sources: Abu Dhabi authoritative annual land-cover or land-use product
independent_validation.current_claim: Public-data results are stress tests and do not validate actual 2023-2024 Abu Dhabi change.
